concept: I am the resurrection and the life

queries.NABRE: I am the resurrection and the life; whoever believes in me, even if he dies, will live
I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end

concept: Take, eat — this is my body

queries.NABRE: Take and eat; this is my body which will be given up for you
The angel Gabriel was sent from God to a virgin betrothed to a man named Joseph
For a child is born to us, a son is given to us; upon his shoulder dominion rests
Behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and they shall name him Emmanuel
He humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, even death on a cross

concept: Christ in you, the hope of glory

queries.NABRE: Christ in you, the hope of glory

concept: Gloria — Glory to God in the highest

queries.NABRE: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests
